theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_finrank_le_of_growth
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (C : ℝ≥0∞), C ≠ ∞ → (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ν (ball 0 R) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n)) → 0 < ν (ball 0 1) → Module.finrank ℝ V ≤ n
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
